subject.title: fix: workflow sanity audit passes on main

question: Do the auto-response and labeler jobs need repository Contents-read access for their actual post-token operations, or should Workflow Sanity be satisfied without broadening these App tokens?
rationale: The diff changes credential scope rather than only workflow metadata; code inspection must establish whether the added read permission is operationally necessary before maintainers accept the expanded boundary.

options.title: Require usage proof before merge
options.body: Confirm the repository-content API or Git operation each job performs and include redacted after-fix workflow output; retain the scope only for jobs that need it.

options.title: Accept the scope expansion
options.body: Accept `contents: read` as the repository automation baseline if maintainers intentionally want these App tokens to have that broader read capability.

recommendation.title: Require usage proof before merge
recommendation.body: Confirm the repository-content API or Git operation each job performs and include redacted after-fix workflow output; retain the scope only for jobs that need it.
